senses.gloss: m. (דקל; v. דֶּקֶל) anything made of thin twigs or reeds (cmp. דְּקוּרָא);

units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 7a:12">Snh. 7ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>היא ניימא וד׳ שפיל</he> when she slumbers, the basket (upon her head) drops (laziness begets ruin).
<cite ref="Megillah 7b:2">Meg. 7ᵇ</cite> (prov.) if a peasant become a king, <he>ד׳ מצואריה וכ׳</he> the basket will never come down from his neck (he will always betray his low birth).
<cite ref="Pesachim 112b:8">Pes. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>ריש תורא בד׳ וכ׳</he> even when the ox has his head in the fodder basket, &c.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 83b:12">B. Mets. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ ד׳ וכ׳</he> basketfuls of fat.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 75a:13">Ab. Zar. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>דקולי</he> ed., v. <cite ref="H01131"><he>חַלְתָּא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 78b">Yoma 78ᵇ</cite> <he>בדיקו׳</he> Ar. (Ms. M. <he>בדקולי</he>, ed. <he>בדיַבְלֵי</he>, Var. in Mss. <he>דכולי</he>, <he>דיקורי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).
